name: @activepieces/piece-postmark
description: Transactional email platform for sending email, templates, and retrieving delivery and bounce insights.

auth.description: Create or copy a Postmark Server API Token from Servers → API Tokens in Postmark.

send_email.name: send_email
send_email.description: Send a single transactional email using Postmark.

from.description: Sender email address configured in Postmark.

aiMetadata.description: Sends one transactional email through Postmark with an inline subject and body (text, HTML, or both). Use to deliver a one-off ad-hoc message; for content driven by a saved Postmark template use Send Email With Template instead. Requires a From address verified on the Postmark server and at least one of text or HTML body. Not idempotent: each call dispatches a new email.

send_email_with_template.name: send_email_with_template
send_email_with_template.description: Send an email using a Postmark template ID and template model.

from.description: Sender email address configured in Postmark.

templateModel.description: JSON object used to populate the Postmark template.

aiMetadata.description: Sends a transactional email rendered from a saved Postmark template, populating it with a template model (the JSON of merge variables). Use when the message content lives in a Postmark template rather than being composed inline; for free-form subject and body use Send Email instead. Requires the numeric template ID and a verified From address. Not idempotent: each call dispatches a new email.

get_email_bounces.name: get_email_bounces
get_email_bounces.description: List bounces from your Postmark server.

count.description: Maximum number of bounces to return (max 500).

offset.description: Number of bounces to skip before returning results.

type.description: Optional bounce type filter, for example HardBounce.

inactive.description: Filter by inactive bounces only. When not set, both active and inactive bounces are returned.

emailFilter.description: Filter results by bounced recipient email address.

messageId.description: Filter results by Postmark message ID.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves a paginated list of email bounces recorded on the Postmark server. Use to inspect delivery failures or check whether a specific recipient bounced; optional filters narrow by bounce type, inactive-only, recipient email, or message ID, and leaving them empty returns all bounces. Read-only and idempotent.

get_delivery_stats.name: get_delivery_stats
get_delivery_stats.description: Retrieve delivery statistics for the current Postmark server.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves aggregate delivery statistics for the Postmark server, including bounce-rate breakdowns by type. Use to report on overall email health for the server; it takes no inputs and is scoped to the authenticated server token. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: Create or copy a Postmark Server API Token from Servers → API Tokens in Postmark.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
